links.comparator_used: Zero-shot GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o and Uro_Chat without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Mean rate of correct answers (RoCA) on 200 European Board of Urology in-service assessment questions over 10 runs
links.effect: UroBot-4o (RAG with 2023 EAU guidelines) 88.4% vs GPT-4o zero-shot 77.6% (+10.8%); highest inter-run agreement (Fleiss' kappa 0.979); urologists' published average 68.7%
links.quote: UroBot-4o achieved the highest RoCA, with an average of 88.4%, outperforming GPT-4o (77.6%) by 10.8%.
